Beta Post Matric Scholarship

Implemented by the Department of Test Education for SC and ST students.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students belonging to Scheduled Castes studying in Class 11 onwards (post-matric) in a recognised institution.
  • Annual family income below Rs. 2.5 lakh.

Benefits

Maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,200 per month and full tuition fee reimbursement.

Last date of application: 30-09-2026
